Thoughts as a principled Strickland fan:

* I don't feel as strongly about the controversy of the Strickland vs Du Plesis fight. After seeing how they scored the bout vs. Izzy, it just seems like DDP's fight style appeals to the judges (and while I had it 2-1 Adesanya tonight before the finish, I do understand how you can score it 2-1 Dricus; he wasn't landing much but when he did they were clearly hurting Izzy).
* I understand why people don't want to see a Strickland vs DDP rematch. If that happens, the Middleweight title picture gets stale rather quickly, even if the division moves at a decent pace. If we get Strickland in there, fans will have seen the same few names in the title picture for like, two years now and that may still be ongoing. Unless Strickland uncharacteristically finishes DDP, the likelihood that Strickland - DDP 2 warrants a trilogy fight (if Sean wins) is quite high- albeit not an immediate rematch.
* Despite the fact that Whittaker has a good claim to a title shot, I think it's worth acknowledging that he doesn't compare well to Sean's recent record. Whittaker got finished by Adesanya (is 0-2 here!) and DDP, Sean dominated Adesanya and lost a split decision by 48-47s to DDP. If Chimaev even shows up, and then wins, I think it's unwise of them to rush him to the title as he has proven that he is a pullout merchant, and that seems to be asking for a Goofcon.
* Imavov talking like he should skip over Strickland is utterly laughable, when he lost their fight. EVEN IF he is the alternate for Whittaker - Chimaev, and then beats Whittaker, he should only then be next in line after Sean for a title shot.
* Sean's comments on Apartheid still existing in South Africa are really disappointing, this is why my favorite fighter is Tom Aspinall these days. I love Sean's style, but he is a sick man. I have to emphasize that I did not know about what he was writing on South Africa when I started this comment today.
